objects.name: Story_text
objects.string: HQ to Converter, the Gridbreaker Syndicate realized your skill with basic conversion and has gone to their plan B, hexadecimal. Now you have to convert their binary to numbers and letters to fix the system. Remember to break the binary into two groups of 4 bits, the first half is a number 0-9, and the other half is from 10-15

objects.name: Hint
objects.string:
remember to group in 4s from right to left
Hex goes 0-15, 0-9 are regular decimal and 10-15 are A-F

EX: 01101011 -> 01101011 = 6 B
